claims.text: The dataset consists of more than 70,000 US English phone conversations, each averaging 11 minutes in duration.
The dataset includes conversations spanning various domains such as account inquiries, refund requests, and service cancellations.
A sample of 500 rescored intent annotations was taken from the dataset for evaluation purposes.
